newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares up in low turnover on BSE.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares up in low turnover on BSE.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose in reduced turnover on Thursday on the Beirut Stock exchange.
A shares rose 1.67 percent to $113.75 from Wednesday's $111.8750 and B shares were fractionally up to $115.875 from $115.250.
Turnover fell to 6,746 shares from 7,281 on Wednesday, and value was $765,659.25 from $812,106.5.
There was no trade for the fourth successive day this week in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic. None of the shares were traded last week.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.32 percent to 84.37 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.87 percent to 977.49.
